# Cryptid Hollow

> Cryptid Hollow is a free cozy farming and life sim game for iPhone and iPad where the neighbors are friendly cryptids. Bigfoot runs the general store, Mothman delivers the mail and Nessie lives in the pond. It arrives on the App Store on December 15, 2026, and pre-orders are open now. It is made by Jobin LLC, a one-person studio in the United States.

## Quick facts

- Name: Cryptid Hollow
- Genre: cozy farming game, life sim, cozy game
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later). Also runs on Macs with Apple silicon.
- Price: free to download, with optional in-app purchases. No ads.
- Release date: December 15, 2026. Pre-order: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6833133647
- Developer and publisher: Jobin LLC
- Tone: cozy, funny and dry. No combat, no way to lose, and nothing wilts while you are away.
- Good for people who like: Stardew Valley, Animal Crossing, Hay Day, cozy games, farming sims, cryptids, folklore, Bigfoot, Mothman.

## What you do in the game

- Grow crops, raise chickens, cows and sheep, and make goods in a mill, creamery, loom and jam kitchen.
- Fill orders for Bigfoot's General Store and load Captain Kraken's ferry.
- Fish at Nessie's pond and off the dock with Captain Kraken: 40 kinds of fish that change with the season, time of day and weather. Every fish has a size, and treasure chests sometimes come up with a catch.
- Catch 15 bugs and spot 15 birds for your journals, and donate fish, bugs and 12 lost human things to the Hollow Museum (67 exhibits), run by the Flatwoods Monster. Tap any exhibit for real facts about it.
- Spot 3 rare cryptids (the Squonk, the Loveland Frogman and the Hodag). They only turn up once in a while; foggy nights are the best chance.
- Collect 12 golden Hollow Pass keepsakes, one for finishing each month's premium pass, and 48 seasonal decorations from the Fresno Nightcrawler's weekend cart.
- 57 Game Center achievements and 3 leaderboards.
- Befriend the cryptids: Bigfoot, Mothman, Nessie, the Jersey Devil, the Chupacabra, the Lizard Man, the Owlman, the Sheepsquatch, the Jackalope, the Yeti, Captain Kraken, the Flatwoods Monster, the Fresno Nightcrawler and more. Each has a story and a birthday.
- Fix up Great-Aunt Millie's farmhouse and decorate the farm and the town square.
- Sell goods at your own roadside stand, visit friends' farms and join a weekly derby through Game Center.
- Come back each day for the mail, a daily dig spot, the Owlman's weather forecast and Mothman's prophecies, and on weekends a traveling cart with decorations you can't get anywhere else. The town clock shows the real time.
